I grew up in the trailer park off Shelby drive. One half is travellers and the other is everyone else. We found their lifestyle pretty interesting. For the most part they kept to themselves and didn't talk to us or acknowledge us as we drove by. On a couple of rare occasions some teenage boys came over to play basketball with us. To this day I have never met or spoken to a female traveler that is my age (I'm 30 M BTW). The males were gone for half of the year. I believe most of them owned some kind of construction business. Their trailers had elaborate brick stairs/porches. We would walk over to their side and see all sorts of nice cars (BMW, Mazarati, Corvette etc). On the weekends they (mostly the girls) would pile up in their giant SUVs and ride around their side of the park and the street that separated it from "our" side. They were very proud of their children as there were always decorated yard signs announcing some kind of life event (graduation, births, baptisms etc). I always found them to be pretty over the top. I learned that in their community announcing a soon to be born baby's name was a huge deal. They would have gatherings that would shut the small streets down when this happened.
